title: Leaving the studios for New York: Tatum tribute, the Cookery and Bradley's
summary: He played the Art Tatum tribute at the Jazz Festival, then the Cookery and Bradley's and spent years in New York.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: So then I came back, and I went into the studios and back with ...(?)... and this and that -- and I was sick and tired of the studios. And I had an opportunity to play the Jazz Festival back here, the tribute to Art Tatum, so I took it. Then that gave me a week with a trio at...
Anyway, I worked up there for a week. Then I went back

to Los Angeles. Then I got a call from the Cookery for seven weeks. So I went to the Cookery. I used to start hanging around at Bradley's. Then the first thing you know, I'm working at Bradley's... And the first thing you know, I'm working at Bradley's, and I stumbled around New York for about five-six-seven years, where I got to know people like you and... I didn't know anybody, you know. I was a lonesome polecat from L.A., buried in the studios.
You know most of what went on from there...
